boundaries.name: \Gamma_H
boundaries.description: heated gas-side boundary; convective heating combined with absorbed gas radiation

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: cooling edges exchanging heat with ambient air; their shape is optimised

constants.name: h
constants.description: effective convective heat transfer coefficient (air side)

constants.name: epsilon_g
constants.description: effective emissivity of the gas-filled duct and oxidised wall

objective.name: J
objective.description: Minimise the gas-side surface temperature at fixed material cost; the heated-surface temperature integral is weighted by q_b, keeping the heated surface cold.

state_equation.description: Non-linear steady heat conduction with convection on the cooling edges and a non-linear radiation term on the heated gas-side boundary; the u^4 dependence makes the problem non-linear. No Dirichlet condition (temperature fixed implicitly by ambient air through the Robin condition).
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi \left( \nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u \right) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_H} \varepsilon_g \sigma u^{4} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u_{H} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_H} \varepsilon_g \sigma u_{H}^{4} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_H
boundaries.description: heated gas-side boundary; convective heating combined with absorbed gas radiation
boundaries.rationale: Label 1 assigned to the heated gas-side boundary (bottom edge) based on mesh_labels_used and typical heat sink layout; kind and design_role preserved from extracted spec.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: cooling edges exchanging heat with ambient air; their shape is optimised
boundaries.rationale: Label 2 assigned to one of the cooling edges (left edge) based on mesh_labels_used; kind and design_role preserved from extracted spec.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: cooling edges exchanging heat with ambient air; their shape is optimised
boundaries.rationale: Label 3 assigned to the other cooling edge (right edge) based on mesh_labels_used; kind and design_role preserved from extracted spec.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: Field u extracted from spec; dirichlet_value and dirichlet_labels are designed as empty because no Dirichlet condition is given (temperature fixed implicitly via Robin conditions).

constants.name: h
constants.description: effective convective heat transfer coefficient (air side)

constants.name: epsilon_g
constants.description: effective emissivity of the gas-filled duct and oxidised wall

optimization_config.rationale: Standard parameters for level-set shape optimization on a unit square: hmin=0.01, hmax=0.1 (1% and 10% of domain size), diffusion=1e-4 to regularize the level set, v0=1e-3 initial velocity, 30 iterations. boundary_labels and fixed_labels reflect the design roles: cooling edges (labels 2,3) are movable; heated gas-side boundary (label 1) is fixed. The level-set initial formula encodes a full solid square with a circular hole of radius 0.1 at the center.
